name: all-ops-match-order-is-by-op-name
note: A multi-key leaf is an implicit all whose children run in op-name order, not in the order the keys are authored. The rule authors regex first, yet the trace reads keywords_any, min_chars, regex.

name: first-op-false-short-circuits-rest
note: keywords_any comes first and is false, so the implicit all short-circuits and neither min_chars (which would pass) nor regex is evaluated: the trace holds one entry.

name: min_chars-runs-before-regex
note: regex is the last child, so a failing regex is reached only after min_chars passed: the trace holds three entries ending in regex. Were regex evaluated second, the all would short-circuit there and min_chars would be missing.
